name: s2_single_moving
description: SCENARIO S2 - single moving obstacle. One obstacle crosses the straight-line route between start and goal at a constant, documented speed. Same 10 x 6 m arena as default_10x6 so results stay comparable with the static baseline; the only changed factor is that the obstacle moves. All coordinates are DNS: +x forward, +y right, fixed altitude, fixed yaw.

obstacles._comment: Constant-speed back-and-forth across the route. 'linear' is a triangle wave: the centre travels at exactly speed_mps except at the two turning points, so the crossing speed is a single documented number rather than an instantaneous peak. One full cycle covers 4 * amplitude = 8.0 m of travel, giving a period of 8.0/0.5 = 16.0 s. phase_rad 0 starts the obstacle at y = -2.0 (the drone's left), 4.6 m from the start point, so it is never overlapping the drone at reset.

collision._comment: The geometric test sweeps the drone segment against the obstacle disc at both endpoints of the step, so a fast-moving obstacle cannot tunnel through the drone between samples.
